free_tier.stated: Free plan: 1,000 credits every month, no credit card required; the allotment resets each monthly cycle and unused credits do not roll over. Interact bills 2 credits per browser minute for code-only sessions and 7 with a prompt, with a one-minute minimum, so the free pool is 500 code-only browser minutes a month
free_tier.notes: credits are shared across search, scrape, crawl and interact; 1 credit is 1 page on a basic scrape
